overall: The AG found the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing a draft conservation restriction in executive session under Purpose 6, which did not apply; no further relief was ordered because the minutes were already released.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission improperly entered executive session on Feb. 7, 2019 to discuss a draft conservation restriction for Town Center parcels.
allegations.key_passage: Since the conservation restriction discussions did not fit within a proper purpose for executive session, we find the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law.
